{{Lang|Yi'an|zh= 逸安}} is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Yi'an can be found leaning against a wall at the northern border of Hongzhen.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yi'an:''' Have you talked to [[Yuanzhi]] yet?
:{{DIcon}} (Nod.) 
:'''Yi'an:''' She told you everything, I presume?
:'''Yi'an:''' She wants to go to school in Jinzhou and maybe become a researcher... That's what she said.
:'''Yi'an:''' Being a researcher doesn't sound that impressive to me...
:'''Yi'an:''' I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great. 
:{{DIcon}} There are pros and cons in either choice.
::'''Yi'an:''' Well, I'm not trying to say who's right or wrong. Everybody has their own perspective.
::'''Yi'an:''' But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
:{{DIcon}} What Yuanzhi needs is your understanding.
::'''Yi'an:''' We've been friends for years, so I can understand her...
::'''Yi'an:''' But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
:{{DIcon}} You're just afraid of losing a friend.
::'''Yi'an:''' You're probably right all along...
::'''Yi'an:''' I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
:'''Yi'an:''' The gap between me an her seems to grow wider and wider... 
:'''Yi'an:''' Regardless, I still respect her decision to become a researcher. After all, it's the path she's chosen for herself.
:'''Yi'an:''' I wouldn't like it either if she were telling me how to live my life.
:'''Yi'an:''' She's my friend, so the least I can do is wish her happiness.
{{Dialogue End}}
